# Teaching

I teach courses designed to help students develop practical skills and frameworks at the intersection of strategy, artificial intelligence, and product management. My teaching philosophy emphasizes hands-on experience.

---

# College Courses

## Product Management with AI
[Course Website](https://byu-strategy.github.io/product-management/)

Students become full-stack AI product builders. Each student picks a problem worth solving, builds a real digital product for it, puts it in front of real users, and ships it, using AI coding agents as the primary tool throughout. The course is organized around six builder skills: agentic workflow, discovery, design, application architecture, AI systems, and launch and learn. Students build with Claude Code, GitHub, Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel, and no prior experience with any of them is required.

## AI Foundry
[Course Website](https://byu-strategy.github.io/ai-foundry/) · [AI Foundry Website](https://aifoundry.byu.edu)

The [AI Foundry](https://aifoundry.byu.edu) is an AI-native product studio and consultancy, and an experiential learning program of the BYU Marriott School of Business. MBA and undergraduate students scope real projects and ship production AI systems for paying clients. I serve as its faculty advisor.

## Introduction to Management Consulting
[Course Website](https://byu-strategy.github.io/management-consulting/)

This course provides an introduction to structured problem solving, client engagement, and the core toolkit of management consulting. Students learn how to frame problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and deliver clear, compelling recommendations that create positive impact for organizations.

## Associate Product Manager Lab
[Course Website](https://byu-strategy.github.io/apm-lab/)

The Associate Product Manager (APM) Lab is an apprenticeship-style internship where students work on real product initiatives at partner companies while earning academic credit. Over a 4-month term, students contribute to product discovery, feature definition, prototyping, and analytics support. The program is designed for high-performing students with strong foundations in product management, data analysis, and AI-native workflows.

## Strategy Leadership Lab
[Course Website](https://byu-strategy.github.io/strategy-leadership-lab/)

Strategy Leadership Lab is a weekly working session for the roughly 30 students who lead the BYU Strategy Program and the four career clubs it administers. Each session combines leadership development (guest speakers, case discussions, and skill building on influence, conflict, and managing up) with a project roundtable where club and program leaders coordinate on shared priorities and give each other feedback. Enrollment is open to program and club leaders regardless of major.

# Corporate Bootcamps

I offer intensive 4-hour workshops designed for professionals and organizations looking to rapidly upskill in AI-powered product development and structured problem-solving.

## AI PM Bootcamp
[Workshop Website](https://byu-strategy.github.io/ai-pm-bootcamp/)

This workshop defines the emergence of the "full-stack product builder"—a professional capable of managing strategy, design, engineering, go-to-market, and data science with the help of AI tools. Participants learn vibe coding, spec-driven development, GitHub workflows, and how to deploy live applications using Claude Code, Supabase, and Vercel.

## The Consultant's OS

The Consultant's OS is the behavioral operating system that drives performance at top consulting firms. It describes a complete way of thinking, working, and communicating that you can apply throughout your career. This 4-hour workshop teaches the core consultant's toolkit to any professional looking to level up. Topics include: MECE logic for breaking down complex problems, the Pyramid Principle for executive communication, and practical frameworks for driving outcomes with clarity and confidence. The workshop also shows how to amplify each of these skills with AI.

# Open-Source Resources

## Agent Team Kit
[GitHub Repository](https://github.com/ai-foundry-byu/agent-team-kit)

Tooling and working agreements for a two-person AI-native team, or a solo developer running many Claude Code agents at once. It handles the collisions parallel agents run into (dev-server ports, the shared database, and the git working tree) and supports two ways of working: every agent on one main branch, or each agent in its own git worktree. AI Foundry teams use it to build client projects.
